name: library_inclusions_for_es2024_target_6f757831
subject: Fix library inclusions for ES2024 target (#60622)
not_strict_reasons: no failing case added by the fix

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Adds the missing ES2024 entry to targetToLibMap and getDefaultLibFileName so ES2024 targets get lib.es2024.full.d.ts. Without it the library inclusion was wrong for that target. Many symlink watch baselines change as a result.
